mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5% over two consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) in periods when FEDFUNDS > 5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% coincident with a rise in the unemployment rate above 6% signals weakening demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both GDPC1 YoY < -2% and UNRATE > 6%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase of more than 0.5 percentage points in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is followed by negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened recession risk and lower consumer spending.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 1% for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings for industrial firms and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month by > 1% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during three consecutive months of >1% INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly increase in the housing starts index (HOUST) and a decline in real personal savings (RSAFS) signals a shift toward consumption-financed housing demand, which historically precedes equity market weakness over the next 20 trading days due to rising household leverage.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises AND RSAFS falls month-over-month
regime_hint: low savings, high housing activity regime
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST rises and RSAFS falls month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% for more than six months in a low-inflation environment signals accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS < 1% for > 6 months and CPIAUCSL < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment increase (PAYEMS) below 50,000 persons for three consecutive months signals persistent labor market weakness, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during three consecutive months of PAYEMS < 50,000.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 0.5% signals robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 rises by > 0.5% month-over-month.
